{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Configs

|descr= Gets a number defined in config and retype it into a boolean. Everything greater than 0 is [[true]], otherwise it is [[false]].
* Default syntax works for any config
* Alternative syntax is for comfortable working with mission's [[Description.ext]].

|s1= config call [[BIS_fnc_getCfgDataBool]]

|p1= config: [[Config]] - [[Config]] path

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|s2= array call [[BIS_fnc_getCfgDataBool]]

|p21= [[Array]] of [[String]]s - [[missionConfigFile]] classes and an attribute

|r2= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>private _value = (missionConfigFile >> "Characters" >> "Default" >> "equipAdjust") call BIS_fnc_getCfgDataBool;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _value = ["Characters", "Default", "equipAdjust"] call BIS_fnc_getCfgDataBool;</sqf>
